items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Estella Williams, one of our members, sang

ctx.x: jam-packed and Amos got the bass player, Lou Morrow, who lives out that way and Rudy Walker, a drummer who lives out that way and we brought Stash O'Loughlin, a piano player, Alan Hanlon on guitar. Alan and Flo Hanlon are members of the House that Jazz Built. Flo sings, and so we had quite a show.
Florence sang, the bass players wife, Lynn Morrow, she sang, Estella Williams, one of our members, sang and we had Carmen Leggio -- Wilma De Ric our secretary brought Carmen Leggio and his wife.

He plays tenor and she plays flute. They played. I, of course, sang and we have a young man, blues singer, Claudio Maxwell who sang -- he's a blues singer, he sang. And after he got through he practically took over and acted as the M.C.
